rows.jyutping: nau2 haa2 nau2 haa2 gam3 haang4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an animal moving forward with a smooth side-to-side motion.

example.english: The snake can slither across the road.
example.traditional: 條蛇可以扭吓扭吓咁行過條馬路。
example.jyutping: tiu4 se4 ho2 ji5 nau2 haa2 nau2 haa2 gam3 haang4 gwo3 tiu4 maa5 lou6

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on the animal wriggling or twisting its body rather than specifically on travelling forward.

example.english: The snake is still trying to slither around in the net after being caught.
example.traditional: 條蛇畀人捉住喇，仲喺個網入面扭動緊。
example.jyutping: tiu4 se4 bei2 jan4 zuk1 zyu6 laa3 zung6 hai2 go3 mong5 jap6 min6 nau2 dung6 gan2

rows.note: Use this for slow worm-like movement, especially in more formal or descriptive contexts.

example.english: The snake will slither slowly across the mud.
example.traditional: 條蛇會喺泥地上緩慢蠕動。
example.jyutping: tiu4 se4 wui5 hai2 nai4 dei6 soeng6 wun6 maan6 jyu4 dung6
